raw_segments.text: Through the hush of air a voice sang to them, low, not rain, not leaves and murmur, like
no voice of strings or reeds or what diao call them dulcimers touching their still ears
with words, still hearts of their each his remembered lives.
Sorrow from them each seemed to from both depart when first they heard.
When first they saw lost Richie Poldy, Mercy of Beauty, heard from a person wouldn't
expect it in the least, her first merciful, love-soft, oft-loved word.
Sorrow from them each seemed to from both depart when first they heard.
